Highlights: New Features
* (GBF) Sunrise Orange exterior color
* (GN3) Pacific Blue Metallic exterior color
* (GXE) Lagoon exterior color
* (ES6) Jet Black / Twilight Blue interior
* (HWO) Jet Black with Red accents interior
* (H6K) Jet Black / Storm Sky Gray with Argon Orange accents interior

* (WPC) Comfort and Convenience Package, includes (DA1) rear seat armrest, (B7S) cargo privacy cover, (C59) rear air vent, (AVJ) Keyless Open, (KA1) heated driver and front passenger seat, (N5F) wrapped steering wheel, (KI3) heated steering wheel, (DLF) outside heated power mirrors and (V59) side rails
* (ZL3) Power Convenience Package, includes (K7A) Wireless Phone Charging and (TB5) power liftgate
* (HS1) Safety Alert Seat
* (UOW) Side Bicyclist Alert
* (CTB) Intersection Automatic Emergency Braking
* (UVZ) Reverse Automatic Braking
* (DA1) Rear seat armrest with cupholders
* (U5G) 5G vehicle connectivity
* Black front and rear bowties on all models
* Roof-mounted body-color shark fin antenna
* (TB5) Power liftgate
* (VTI) Front upper grille active shutters
* (UGE) LED tail lamps
* (Q6W) 17" Deep Space Gray machined aluminum wheels on LT
* (PZS) 19" Carbon Flash Metallic machined aluminum wheels on RS
* (RQK) 18" Android Dark Gray machined aluminum wheels on ACTIV
* (JM8) Automatic vehicle hold
Changes
* (KSG) Adaptive Cruise Control is now standard on all models
* (UKI) Blind Zone Steering Assist replaces (UKC) Lane Change Alert with Side Blind Zone Alert
* (UKM) Lane Keep Assist with Departure Warning replaces (UHX) Lane Keep Assist with Departure Warning
* (UFB) Rear Cross Traffic Braking replaces (UFG) Rear Cross Traffic Alert
* (UD5) Front and Rear Park Assist replaces (UD7) Rear Park Assist
* (UGN) Enhanced Automatic Emergency Braking replaces (UHY) Automatic Emergency Braking
* (UKT) Front Pedestrian and Bicyclist Braking replaces (UKJ) Front Pedestrian Braking
* (URL) 11.3" diagonal advanced color LCD display with Google Built-In compatibility infotainment/audio system replaces (IVA) 11" diagonal color touchscreen
* (UBJ) USB ports are now all type-C (2), located within the instrument panel
* (URF) 11" diagonal display Driver Information Center replaces (URO) 8" diagonal display Driver Information Center
* (KI3) Heated steering wheel replaces (UVD) heated steering wheel
* (K7A) Wireless Phone Charging replaces (K4C) Wireless Charging
* (KTI) Tire inflator kit is now standard and (ZDC) spare tire with wheel and jack is available
